injection.design: one uniformly chosen valid center per heat-gas-seed, reused across all doses/delays and A/B; positive packet added directly to frozen V2 input flow and gas
injection.null_control: one source-only injection per heat-gas-seed, not duplicated across response delays or doses
injection.estimand: known delay of added perturbations, not a physically labelled industrial event

B_definition: eligible lags require shifted-target std >= 0.05 whole-record target std; source gate unchanged; competitors restricted to eligible lags
B_full_competitor_diagnostic: same B winner, but retain all finite raw-lag competitors for separation; diagnostic only, not a third proposed formal model
